name: Cyanoscum Bloom

generalAbilities.name: Water Sense
generalAbilities.description: A cyanoscum can sense the presence of water within 60 feet as an imprecise sense.

defensiveAbilities.name: Regeneration 5 (Deactivated by Fire)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster regains the listed number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn. Its Dying condition never increases beyond Dying 3 as long as its regeneration is active. However, if it takes damage of a type listed in the regeneration entry, its regeneration deactivates until the end of its next turn. Deactivate the regeneration before applying any damage of a listed type, since that damage might kill the monster by bringing it to Dying 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Toxic Exposure
defensiveAbilities.description: Creatures inside the cyanoscum bloom's space are exposed to cyanoscum toxin. A creature can't reduce the poison below stage 1 while it shares a space with the cyanoscum bloom.

offensiveAbilities.name: Cyanoscum Toxin
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 18 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d4 Poison Damage damage and Slowed 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 1d6 Poison Damage damage and Slowed 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 1d8 Poison Damage damage and Paralyzed (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Frenzied Scratching
offensiveAbilities.description: Each enemy in the cyanoscum bloom's space takes 3d6 Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 18 Reflex Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Squish
offensiveAbilities.description: A cyanoscum bloom can Squeeze through spaces that aren't airtight at half its Speed per round.

recallKnowledge: Arcana or Nature or Nature, DC 19
